name: GitHub Actions CI
prompt: This folder is a small Node.js project. Create a `package.json` with a `test` script (a trivial test is fine). Then add a GitHub Actions CI workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs on every push and pull request, checks out the code, sets up the current Node.js LTS version with npm caching, runs `npm ci` and then `npm test`. Commit nothing; just write the files.
